name: Anycubic Kobra 2 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
G90 ; Use absolute coordinates
M83 ; Extruder relative mode
M140 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; Start bed heating
M104 S150 ; Soft pre-heat nozzle to prevent oozing
M190 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; Wait for bed temp
G28 ; Home all axes
M420 S1 ; Load and activate EEPROM bed leveling mesh (CRITICAL)
G1 Z2.0 F3000 ; Lift nozzle
G1 X0.1 Y20 Z0.3 F5000.0 ; Move to purge position
M104 S[first_layer_temperature] ; Set final nozzle temp
M109 S[first_layer_temperature] ; Wait for nozzle temp
G92 E0 ; Reset extruder
G1 X0.1 Y180.0 Z0.3 F1500.0 E15 ; Purge line 1
G1 X0.4 Y180.0 Z0.3 F5000.0 ; Shift side
G1 X0.4 Y20.0 Z0.3 F1500.0 E30 ; Purge line 2
G92 E0 ; Reset extruder
G1 E-1.0 F2400 ; Direct-drive retract 1mm
G1 Z2.0 F3000 ; Lift nozzle
G1 X5 Y20 F5000 ; Wipe clear of line
machine_end_gcode:
M400 ; Wait for buffer to clear
M104 S0 ; Turn off extruder
M140 S0 ; Turn off bed
M107 ; Turn off fan
G91 ; Relative positioning
G1 E-1.0 F2400 ; Direct-drive safe 1mm retract (prevents clogs)
G1 Z+5.0 F3000 ; Lift print head
G90 ; Absolute positioning
G1 X0 Y215 F3000 ; Present bed forward for easy removal
M84 X Y E ; Disable motors
